ruleDefinitions.name: Lsass Full Dump Request Via DumpType Registry Settings
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the setting of the "DumpType" registry value to "2" which stands for a "Full Dump". Technique such as LSASS Shtinkering requires this value to be "2" in order to dump LSASS. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\Windows\\ Error\\ Reporting\\\\LocalDumps\\\\DumpType.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\Windows\\ Error\\ Reporting\\\\LocalDumps\\\\lsass\\\.exe\\\\DumpType.*")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000002\)")
